import asyncio, inspect, json, os, sys
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from unittest.mock import patch
from devtools.core.paths import ResolvedPath
from devtools.core.time import Duration
from devtools.resources.commands import Command, CommandExecutor

def raises(kind, operation, message):
    try:
        operation()
    except kind:
        return
    raise AssertionError(message)

def model_checks(cls):
    assert "environment" in inspect.signature(cls).parameters, "Command must accept optional environment overrides"
    original = {"DEVTOOLS_Q10_OVERRIDE": "snapshot", "DEVTOOLS_Q10_EMPTY": ""}
    command = cls(sys.executable, environment=original)
    original["DEVTOOLS_Q10_OVERRIDE"] = "mutated"
    assert isinstance(command.environment, Mapping)
    assert dict(command.environment) == {"DEVTOOLS_Q10_OVERRIDE": "snapshot", "DEVTOOLS_Q10_EMPTY": ""}, "Command must snapshot its environment input"
    raises(TypeError, lambda: command.environment.__setitem__("x", "y") if hasattr(command.environment, "__setitem__") else (_ for _ in ()).throw(TypeError()), "Environment view must reject mutation")
    raises(FrozenInstanceError, lambda: setattr(command, "environment", {}), "Command must remain frozen")
    equal = cls(sys.executable, environment={"DEVTOOLS_Q10_EMPTY": "", "DEVTOOLS_Q10_OVERRIDE": "snapshot"})
    assert command == equal and hash(command) == hash(equal), "Equivalent overrides must have order-independent equality/hash"
    assert command != cls(sys.executable, environment={"DEVTOOLS_Q10_OVERRIDE": "other"}), "Override values participate in equality"
    assert hash(cls(sys.executable)) == hash(cls(sys.executable)), "Default commands remain hashable"
    assert cls(sys.executable).environment is None
    for transformed in (command.args("-V"), command.with_args("-V"), command.without_args(), command.with_executable(sys.executable), command.with_timeout(Duration.seconds(2)), command.without_timeout(), command.cwd(ResolvedPath(Path.cwd())), command.without_cwd()):
        assert dict(transformed.environment) == dict(command.environment), "Existing fluent operations must preserve environment"
    assert hasattr(command, "with_environment") and hasattr(command, "without_environment"), "Expose immutable environment replacement/removal helpers"
    changed = command.with_environment({"DEVTOOLS_Q10_OVERRIDE": "changed"})
    assert dict(changed.environment) == {"DEVTOOLS_Q10_OVERRIDE": "changed"}
    assert command.without_environment().environment is None
    for invalid in ([], "KEY=value", 1, {1: "value"}, {"key": 1}, {"key": None}):
        raises(TypeError, lambda invalid=invalid: cls(sys.executable, environment=invalid), "Environment must be a mapping of strings to strings")
    for invalid in ({"": "x"}, {"a=b": "x"}, {"a\0b": "x"}, {"a": "x\0y"}):
        raises(ValueError, lambda invalid=invalid: cls(sys.executable, environment=invalid), "Invalid process environment names/values must be rejected at construction")
    raises(ValueError, lambda: command.with_environment({"bad=name": "x"}), "Fluent replacements must enforce the same validation")

async def execution_checks(cls, executor_cls):
    script = "import os,json; print(json.dumps({k:os.environ.get(k) for k in ['DEVTOOLS_Q10_OVERRIDE','DEVTOOLS_Q10_INHERIT','DEVTOOLS_Q10_EMPTY']},ensure_ascii=True)); print(os.getcwd())"
    with TemporaryDirectory() as directory, patch.dict(os.environ, {"DEVTOOLS_Q10_OVERRIDE": "parent", "DEVTOOLS_Q10_INHERIT": "inherited", "DEVTOOLS_Q10_EMPTY": "parent"}):
        command = cls(sys.executable, ("-c", script), working_directory=ResolvedPath(Path(directory)), timeout=Duration.seconds(10), environment={"DEVTOOLS_Q10_OVERRIDE": "child-\u03bb", "DEVTOOLS_Q10_EMPTY": ""})
        os.environ["DEVTOOLS_Q10_INHERIT"] = "launch-time"
        before = dict(os.environ)
        results = await asyncio.gather(executor_cls().execute(command), executor_cls().execute(command.with_environment({"DEVTOOLS_Q10_OVERRIDE": "sibling"})), executor_cls().execute(command.without_environment()), executor_cls().execute(command.with_environment({})))
        expected = [
            {"DEVTOOLS_Q10_OVERRIDE": "child-\u03bb", "DEVTOOLS_Q10_INHERIT": "launch-time", "DEVTOOLS_Q10_EMPTY": ""},
            {"DEVTOOLS_Q10_OVERRIDE": "sibling", "DEVTOOLS_Q10_INHERIT": "launch-time", "DEVTOOLS_Q10_EMPTY": "parent"},
            {"DEVTOOLS_Q10_OVERRIDE": "parent", "DEVTOOLS_Q10_INHERIT": "launch-time", "DEVTOOLS_Q10_EMPTY": "parent"},
            {"DEVTOOLS_Q10_OVERRIDE": "parent", "DEVTOOLS_Q10_INHERIT": "launch-time", "DEVTOOLS_Q10_EMPTY": "parent"},
        ]
        for result, values in zip(results, expected, strict=True):
            assert result.succeeded and result.stderr == b"", "Environment-aware commands must execute normally"
            lines = result.stdout.decode().splitlines()
            assert json.loads(lines[0]) == values, "Child overrides must merge with launch-time inheritance and remain isolated"
            assert Path(lines[1]) == Path(directory), "Working-directory behavior must remain unchanged"
            assert result.command.environment is None or isinstance(result.command.environment, Mapping)
        assert dict(os.environ) == before, "Executing commands must never mutate the parent environment"

def run_checks(cls=Command, executor_cls=CommandExecutor):
    model_checks(cls)
    asyncio.run(execution_checks(cls, executor_cls))
    print("PASS: immutable environment model, invalid inputs, fluent/hash compatibility, four concurrent real child-process scenarios and parent isolation")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_checks()
